records.text: Arsen Ostrovsky's photographs from the Bondi attack were staged and his bandages showed no blood.
records.speaker: Bassem Youssef

appearances.snippet: uh the Bondi attack I think I gave pictures to one of your producers like our son Ostrovsky who's like one of those trolls on Twitter he happened to be on October 7th a survivor October 7th and then he posted his picture a selfie while he's on the floor and he has blood all over him yeah that's the picture okay which is obvious looks fake ... not a ... single point like like drop of blood on the bandage

verification.notes: ABC and AFP verified that Arsen Ostrovsky was genuinely injured in the Bondi attack and documented how altered or AI-generated images were used to label him a crisis actor. The staged-photo and no-real-injury allegation is contradicted.

sources.title: This man went viral after surviving Bondi. Then the internet took a dark turn
sources.relevance: Documents Ostrovsky’s real injury and the false conspiracy narrative built around manipulated images.

sources.title: Images of crisis actor at Bondi Beach shooting are AI-generated
